body:
Should it matter if there are `*.rs` files but no `Cargo.toml`?
I don't know that we should be checking for anything but `Cargo.toml` here.
Same here. It doesn't seem very actionable if we have a `*.js` file or `node_modules` folder without a `package.json` file.

This could possibly throw if you don't have read permissions on `package.json`.
`unwrap()` would cause the prompt to panic in that case.
What happens here if `package.json` doesn't have a version?
I believe you can chain these, i.e. `segment.set_style(...).set_value(...)`

You could abstract this logic since it's pretty similar to what you do on 
line 59. It might be handy to have it across many of our segments eventually.

@matchai I get a `vnull` ... which means that the version is `null` and then I appended a `v`

![Shot 2019-04-26 at 08 06 12](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/30328854/56789617-375f7b00-67fa-11e9-9d0e-0d9a9d3e1b28.jpg)
@sirMerr This would over complicate the line ... I'm leaving it as is!

@matchai I'm planning on just making 1 function (`has_file`) that checks to see if there is a certain `file_name` in the current directory. Then I just call `has_file("Cargo.toml")` and `has_file("package.json")`

We should handle the error instead of letting it panic.
I'd take a look at Rust error handling solutions.

What would be the ideal way to handle this scenario?

If `package.json`  doesn't have a version, should we hide the section? If we did, that might be confusing for users, _why does my prompt not work?!_

Or should it say something like ` 📦 NO_VER` or `📦 vN/A` or...?
@Snuggle @matchai I'd personally vote for `📦 NO_VER`. What do you guys think?

In spaceship it has always been `📦⚠️`, which has lead to _a lot_ of confusion. I'd be fine with changing it here.

I'd personally prefer not to show the version section at all, to be honest. 🤔
`📦 NO_VER` is fine with me if that's what most people prefer, but I'm afraid it may just be noisy if people are intentionally omitting a version.

> but I'm afraid it may just be noisy if people are intentionally omitting a version.

@matchai Exactly what I was thinking ... let's leave it out!
